scheme_name: Maintenance Allowance To Backward Class Students Under Training In Sainik Schools
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a domicile/permanent resident of the state of Maharashtra
Applicant must belong to Vimukta Jatis, Nomadic Tribes, or Special Backward Class
Applicant must be studying in Classes 5th to 12th
Applicant must be studying in a Sainik School recognized/approved by the Government of Maharashtra
Applicant should not already be availing the benefits of the scheme
benefits_summary: Training fees of ₹400‑₹2400 are paid to the concerned ITI, and after completion a tool kit worth ₹1000 is provided to the trainee.
